items.statement: After the campaign, the proportion of grade 7 to 9 students up to date for all three adolescent vaccines will be at least 15 percentage points lower in schools in the most deprived quintile than in the least deprived.
items.rationale: The gradient elsewhere was 25 points; knowing its local size targets next year's program.
items.risks: Register undercount of community doses may differ by deprivation.

items.statement: Schools where more than a third of families speak another language at home will have lower consent return and lower coverage than other schools with similar deprivation.
items.rationale: Separating language from deprivation would change how consent is sought.
items.risks: Only school-level language data may be available.

items.statement: Saturday clinics mainly reached students who were absent at school visits rather than students whose consent forms were never returned.
items.rationale: Decides whether Saturday clinics are worth repeating.
items.risks: Clinic lists may not link to the register.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected because it holds in either design.
